messages:
ana (Docs): Quick note APAC-2 cluster went live this morning. Need a tiny docs update: region table, SDK snippet, and a short data residency footnote. Who can help with snippets?

matt (Eng): I pushed the infra change. Host pattern now: api-{region}.inference.redwood.com (hyphen after api). APAC2 id is apac-2, streaming host is stream-apac-2.inference.redwood.com. No API shape changes. For Private we added a `data_residency` boolean in the control plane API.

ana (Docs): Thanks. Can you paste the minimal snippets for python/node that we can drop in? Keep them 2-3 lines.

matt (Eng): Sure:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(region='apac-2')  # auto-resolves endpoint
```

```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ region: 'apac-2' });
```

jia (Intl): I'll add a short localized footnote for JP/KR/FR explaining that artifacts can be stored in-region if `data_residency` is enabled. Will add translations in docs/l10n/geo-footnotes.yaml and link it.

sarah (PM): Note for copy: please use "data residency options" (not "sovereignty") in public docs. Also include a line: "Contact support to request residency guarantees."

kelly (Support): I'll prepare the short support blurb and confirm the SLA/backing language. We should avoid promising legal guarantees without SSO approval.

ana (Docs): Plan: 1) Update Geo availability table — add APAC-2 row with checkmarks for Hosted, Dedicated (beta), Private (requires integration). 2) Add python/js SDK lines in the "Quick start" box. 3) Add data residency footnote with link to compliance page + support path. Drafting PR now.

docs-bot: Docs CI: preview site built for PR #4610 (:white_check_mark:)  https://ci.redwood.ai/pr/4610/preview

matt (Eng): One more micro-note: streaming tips page needs the stream-apac-2 hostname example for users using raw websocket connections.

jia (Intl): Reviewing translations in the PR; will ping when JP/KR copy is ready.

sarah (PM): For Dedicated pricing variance, link to /pricing/regions as matt suggested. Also add a tiny callout: "Pricing for Dedicated capacity may vary by region."

ana (Docs): PR #4610 opened: https://ci.redwood.ai/pr/4610. @jia @sarah @kelly please review. I'll schedule prod merge after approvals and a quick staging sanity check at 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

docs-bot: PR #4610 merged by ana (Docs) (:tada:)  https://ci.redwood.ai/pr/4610/merge

ana (Docs): Deployed to staging and prod. Spot-checked JS snippet and region table. If anyone sees localization formatting oddities, drop a note here and I'll patch immediately. :shipit!
